 IE 11 is not supported. For an optimal experience visit our site on another browser. FOR SUBSCRIBERS Last update 4:00 PM ET Tracking the 2026 early vote
 Share Add NBC News to Google Early voting is underway in the 2026 midterms. Follow the latest national and statewide tallies, including in states with competitive Senate battlegrounds.
 43,547,485 mail-in and early in-person votes cast nationally

 FILTER BY: Party registration Age Gender Vote history 46% 31% 23% Registered Democrats Registered Republicans Other Data not available Source: Party registration is based on a combination of state-provided partisanship when available and TargetSmart’s model of party affiliation. Nationally, the total number of early votes is an aggregation of the daily state totals sourced from TargetSmart and state officials. The total number of ballots requested or sent includes the total number of registered voters in universal vote by mail states, where ballots are automatically sent to all registered voters.
